messages:
auditor_mike: Hi, auditor request: need an evidence bundle for SOC2 control mapping covering S3 objects encrypted with CMKs, ECS task role accesses, k8s RBAC edits, and any incidents touching those resources between 2025-05-01 and 2026-04-30. Prefer CSV/JSON outputs + manifest with SHA256.

sophia (security): We can assemble that. Plan: 1) CloudTrail slice for kms.amazonaws.com events (Decrypt/GenerateDataKey), 2) k8s audit events for RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding changes, 3) Splunk exports for incidents, 4) approval PDFs from ticketing for RBAC changes, 5) signed manifest + signature.

auditor_mike: Need key rotation proof for CMKs used by S3 SSE and secrets. Also request obfuscated usernames but keep ARNs/session IDs and source IPs.

raj (infra): Example Athena query we'll run against the CloudTrail dataset to pull KMS crypto ops:
```
SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters.keyId, sourceIPAddress, eventID
FROM cloudtrail_db.cloudtrail
WHERE eventSource='kms.amazonaws.com'
  AND eventName IN ('Decrypt','GenerateDataKey')
  AND eventTime BETWEEN timestamp '2025-05-01' AND timestamp '2026-04-30';
```
We'll output CSV and raw JSON slice.

sophia (security): CMKs to include in the bundle: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/aa11bb22-cc33-dd44-ee55-ff6677889900 and arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/11aa22bb-33cc-44dd-55ee-667788990011. We'll include key metadata, rotation events, and the AWS KMS audit extraction.

auditor_mike: For RBAC evidence, include before/after YAML where possible and the approval ticket export.

raj (infra): We have RBAC change events exported from the cluster audit sink and CloudTrail for IAM. Sample jq command we use to filter RBAC events:
```
jq -c '.Records[] | select(.detail.eventName|test("(createClusterRoleBinding|patchRoleBinding|deleteRoleBinding|createRoleBinding)"))' k8s-audit-export.json > rbac_delta.json
```
Approval links (we'll PDF-export): https://linear.app/RED/issue/RW-5011 (included).

sophia (security): Incident overlap: ops-bot summary shows INC-2025-11-02 (auth anomaly) and INC-2026-03-18 (storage permission misconfig); we'll attach anchors and Splunk query + exported events. Splunk query example:
```
index=k8s_audit OR index=cloudtrail "RoleBinding" OR "kms:Decrypt" | table _time, user, src_ip, event, request
```
We will redact human-readable emails but preserve principal ARNs and session IDs. Redaction report included.

claire (compliance): Required bundle contents checklist: manifest.json (file list + sha256), crosswalk.csv (control -> artifact), redaction_report.md, rotation_evidence.pdf, approvals.pdf, exported_csvs/, raw_json_slices/, and signature.sig.

sophia (security): Delivery plan: preliminary bundle upload to s3://redwood-compliance/audits/soc2/2026-Q2/mike_bundle_v1.zip within 36 hours for initial review; final bundle after feedback within 7 business days. We'll create detached signature and provide pre-signed download link and verification instructions.

auditor_mike: Chain-of-custody: please include the signing cert fingerprint and the upload timestamp. Also confirm no plaintext key material will be exported.

raj (infra): Confirmed: no key material, only metadata and audit events. Bundle signed with compliance GPG key (fingerprint: AB12 CD34 EF56 7890 AB12 CD34 EF56 7890 AB12 CD34). Upload will be followed by a Linear ticket RW-5099 with presigned URL and verification steps.

sophia (security): Noted — we'll run a sample PII scanner against the exported objects and exclude test datasets. Ping when upload complete. :white_check_mark:
